"""64 maximal-size lines, one at a time (worst-case timing)."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import maxcase, gen3, checker
rng = random.Random(31337)
reqs = []
for i in range(32):
    kind = ["plain","infeas_budget","infeas_mlu","infeas_fail","tight"][i % 5]
    reqs.append(maxcase.build(rng, kind))
for i in range(16):
    reqs.append(gen3.gen_feasible(rng, big=True, tight=True))
for i in range(16):
    import gen_struct
    reqs.append(gen_struct.GENS[i % len(gen_struct.GENS)](rng, rng.randint(0, 2**31-1)))
payloads = [json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) for r in reqs]
assert len(payloads) == 64
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"],
                     stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                     stderr=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=0)
worst = 0.0; worst_line = -1
t_start = time.time()
resp = []
for i, line in enumerate(payloads):
    p.stdin.write((line + "\n").encode()); p.stdin.flush()
    t0 = time.time()
    out = p.stdout.readline()
    dt = time.time() - t0
    resp.append(out.decode())
    if dt > worst: worst, worst_line = dt, i
p.stdin.close(); rc = p.wait()
tot = time.time() - t_start
print("rc=%d total=%.1fs worst=%.2fs at line %d" % (rc, tot, worst, worst_line))
err = p.stderr.read().decode()
if err: print("stderr:", err[:300])
open("_req_max64.jsonl","w").write("\n".join(payloads)+"\n")
open("_res_max64.jsonl","w").write("\n".join(resp)+"\n")
import fullcheck
bad = fullcheck.run("_req_max64.jsonl","_res_max64.jsonl")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PYEOF
python interactive_max.py
